Apple Pay Reportedly Set for India Launch Next Month

Apple Pay is reportedly set to launch in India next month, with initial support expected for Axis Bank credit cards. Sources suggest the digital payment service will become available in October. This potential launch marks Apple's expansion of its payment service into the Indian market.
